text:
Alex (marketing): Quick heads-up — spike in inbound claim latency about an hour ago. Multiple leads stuck in HubSpot enrichment waitlist. We need a short escalation playbook before next week’s webinar.
Riley (revops): Saw it. Round-robin got stuck on overflow pool and enrichment API hit a rate limiter. Logs show many `claim_attempts` queued.
Sam (SDR): Customers in the webinar cohort are going stale. Can we priority-route by source? We should avoid losing warm leads. :warning:
Priya (sales-ops): Agreed. Proposed quick rule: if `lead.source == "webinar"` AND `age_seconds > 60` then route to fallback pool `webinar-immediate` and notify SDR queue. Also add an escalation to on-call at 180s.
Riley (revops): Also: current rotation config is `rotation_timeout=45s` and no jitter — causes thundering. Suggest `rotation_timeout=30s` + `claim_backoff=rand(0,5)` to smooth spikes.
Jordan (eng): Can patch that now. Quick snippet I’ll push: `// claim jitter
claim_backoff = Math.floor(Math.random()*6) // seconds
rotation_timeout = 30 // seconds`
Jordan (eng): I’ll also bump the round-robin TTL to avoid re-queuing loops: `rr_ttl = 90s` for webinar tag.
Alex (marketing): Marketing will standardize tags so routing is reliable — use `utm_campaign=webinar_apr26` and `lead_segment=webinar_live`. Please make sure HubSpot mapping doesn't strip these.
Riley (revops): Noted. Also seeing a race where enrichment returns after SF owner mapping, which causes owner_id to be lost. Proposal: persist owner_id mapping on webhook ack, then update enrichment results asynchronously.
Sam (SDR): For immediate recovery, can we trigger a re-warm email when claim latency > 120s? A gentle nudge keeps them engaged.
Maya (marketing-design): I can mock a 1-line re-warm template. Will need target copy from Sam. 30m turnaround for a simple version.
Priya (sales-ops): SLA update: webinar leads target <=90s to claim, escalate at >180s to on-call. I’ll update the SLA doc and HubSpot workflow text.
Riley (revops): Running a one-off backfill to re-route stuck leads now. I’ll export the CSV for Sales if manual claims are needed.
deploy-bot: Flow change deployed to staging: `hs-workflow-webinar-priority v2`
Jordan (eng): Patch deployed to production: `claim-jitter-hotfix`. Monitoring enabled on `lead.claim.latency` and `enrichment.queue_size`.
Jordan (eng): Early numbers: p95 claim latency down from ~120s to ~28s after hotfix. Will watch for 2 hours.
Riley (revops): Backfill finished — 24 leads re-routed, 5 required manual intervention. Uploading CSV to #sales and sending a short note to owners.
Alex (marketing): Action items recap — Priya: update workflows + SLA doc; Jordan: push and monitor patch (done); Riley: send backfill report; Sam: prep re-warm email and sync with Maya; I’ll coordinate handoff notes with CS.
Sam (SDR): I’ll draft the re-warm email and ping @Maya for design.
Maya (marketing-design): Ping received. Will drop two quick variants by EOD.
Alex (marketing): Thanks all. Let’s reconvene tomorrow 09:00 to confirm SLA metrics and webinar readiness. :thumbsup:
